taste.name: Achromatic house, colour on loan from the photographs
taste.trigger: When choosing a palette for a luxury residential brand that needs to feel rarefied
taste.decision: Chose black #000, near-black #1A1919, white and one grey #717170 with no accent hue over a signature brand colour (gold, navy) applied to type and buttons
taste.reason: Interiors carry warm marble, brass and greenery; an accent colour in the chrome would compete with the product instead of framing it

taste.name: Two voices in one headline
taste.trigger: When a headline has to say both what and how it feels
taste.decision: Chose light (300) display capitals overlapped by a calligraphic script line over a stacked headline plus a separate subheading
taste.reason: The overlap reads as a single gesture, like an engraved card with a signature across it; a subheading under the headline reads as marketing copy
evidence: 'The art' script over 'OF THE SUBLIME' caps
TT Ramillas 300 at 80px/85px, altesse script at 100-114px

taste.name: One curve for every reveal
taste.trigger: When choosing easing for fades, masks and colour changes
taste.decision: Chose a single symmetric in-out curve cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) at 1s-1.6s over per-component easings
taste.reason: A slow start and slow settle makes every reveal feel like the same hand drawing a curtain, which is what makes long scroll feel paced rather than busy
evidence: cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) used 29 times, next curve 7 times

taste.name: Asymmetric collage over a grid
taste.trigger: When showing several interiors in sequence
taste.decision: Chose portrait frames of different sizes offset vertically around a centred tall image, with 180px of white between groups, over an even card grid
taste.reason: Offset frames make the eye travel like walking through rooms; a grid of equal cards reads as inventory
evidence: no CSS grid on the page (gridCount 0)
